beats.text: Welcome to Kollects. In the next few minutes, I'll show you everything, from your first poll to collecting payments.
This is the Kollects home page. You can build polls, forms and quizzes, share them in seconds, and watch the answers arrive live.
Scroll down for the features: instant results, forms and surveys, auto-graded quizzes, file uploads and anonymous responses.
Pricing is simple. The free plan gives you a thousand responses a month, with no credit card.
Let's sign in and take a look inside.
This is your Overview, one place for everything you run on Kollects.
At the top are your totals: every response, what's live right now, and how many polls and forms you've made.
Responses over time shows when people answer. Switch between minutes, hours, days, weeks or months.
Below, compare polls with forms, check the status of everything, and jump straight to your top performers.
Now let's create a poll. Open Polls in the sidebar. Here's every poll, with its status and response count.
Click Create Poll. First, the settings. Give it a title and a short description.
Then choose who can answer. Anonymous means anyone with the link can respond, with no sign-up.
Next, the questions. Type your question, and add the options.
You can mix question types. Let's add an open-ended question, so people can answer in their own words.
Review it once, and publish.
That's it. Your poll is live, and the link is ready to share. Let's copy it.
Open the analytics. See the green Live badge? This page updates in real time.
Now, the respondent's side. They open the link on their phone. No app, and no account.
They pick an answer, add a comment, and submit.
And instantly, on your dashboard, the count goes up and the chart moves. No refresh needed.
As more people answer, everything stays in sync, even the word cloud built from their comments.
Presenting to a room? Open the QR code card, style it, and download it for your slides or posters.
When you're ready, publish the results, so everyone can see the outcome.
Polls are perfect for quick questions. For anything longer, there's Forms.
Each card shows a form's status and responses. Let's open the workshop feedback form.
The Summary tab gives you the big picture: responses, completion, a timeline, and a chart for every question.
Individual lets you read each response, one at a time.
Table shows everything as a spreadsheet, and you can export it all to CSV in one click.
Forms can also be quizzes. Kollects grades every answer automatically, and ranks everyone on a leaderboard.
Now let's build a form from scratch: a registration form for a college tech fest.
Add a title and a description. On Plus and Pro, you can even choose your own link, like kollects.tech/f/techfest.
beats.say: Add a title and a description. On Plus and Pro, you can even choose your own link, like collects dot tech, slash F, slash tech fest.

beats.text: Now the questions. First, a short answer for the attendee's name.
Then a multiple choice question, for the events they want to join.
Here's the best part. Switch on Collect payment via UPI, enter your UPI ID, and set a price for each event.
Forms can have several sections. Let's add one more, with a rating question for feedback.
Review, publish, and copy the link.
Now, the attendee's side. They open the link, type their name, and choose two events. The total updates as they pick.
On the next section, they leave a rating and submit.
Because this form collects a payment, they now see a UPI QR code, with the exact amount, your UPI ID, and a reference note.
Here's how it works. Kollects adds up the prices and creates a standard UPI payment request. Scan it with Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm, or any UPI app, and everything is filled in for them.
The money goes straight to your own account. Kollects never holds your funds, and the note on each payment matches it to the right response.
Back on your dashboard, the registration has already arrived, with the amount due and the payment note, so matching payments takes seconds.
Finally, make Kollects look like your brand. Open the Brand kit from your account menu.
Add your company name, pick an accent colour, then choose a font and a corner style.
The preview updates as you go, for your forms, your QR codes, and the link preview people see when you share.
Save it, and every form you share carries your brand. The brand kit comes with the Plus and Pro plans.
That's Kollects. Build it, share it, and watch the answers come in live. Start free today at kollects.tech.
